configurations.name: integrations
runtimeArgs: . "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" && nvm use 22 && CRON_SECRET=local-test-secret EMAIL_DEV_MODE=true yarn workspace @pyre/integrations dev --port "${PORT:-4330}"

configurations.name: social
runtimeArgs: . "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" && nvm use 22 && cd apps/social && yarn exec vite --port "${PORT:-5175}"
